title: How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?
abstract: arXiv:2610.14772v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. translated_title: 摄像头优先的AI智能体应如何工作？
translated_abstract: 摄像头优先的智能体必须对不断展开的视觉世界实时采取行动。我们认为，未来摄像头优先智能体的核心障碍并非识别能力——多模态模型（无论是视觉-语言模型还是实时/流式模型）都能通过语言实现良好泛化，并且仍然是语义推理的正确工具——而是时间。许多视觉目标是短暂的：它们出现、与查询相关，然后在很短的时间窗口内消失。将记忆绑定到与推理相同的端到端路径上，意味着当单体式流水线完成时，证据早已消失。我们将这一问题形式化为“短暂目标交互”，并提出“感知截止期限契约”，将硬性记忆截止期限与软性推理截止期限相分离，其依据是感觉记忆和工作记忆有界且被动的特性。我们提出了一种双截止期限架构：一条始终开启、有界、非语义的快速路径；以及一种主动记忆机制，在时刻消逝之前将其提交到持久记忆中……
tldr: 本文指出摄像头优先AI智能体的核心障碍是时间而非识别能力，提出将“短暂目标交互”形式化，并设计了一种将硬性记忆截止期限与软性推理截止期限分离的双截止期限架构。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that the central obstacle for camera-first AI agents is time rather than recognition ability, formalizing Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and proposing a two-deadline architecture that separates a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline.
